column4: Association of Professional Bankers-Sri Lanka
(Incorporation)
to  undertake,  promote  and  facilitate  studies  in  the
field  of  Banking  and  Financial  Services  within  or
outside Sri Lanka ;
to  research  and  submit  proposals  to  regulatory
authorities on the maintenance and development of a
sound  banking  structure;
to offer prizes and scholarships or any other awards
encouraging  studies  and  research  in  the  field  of
Banking  and  Financial  Services  and  allied  subjects
etc. ;
to  organize  and  promote  research  in  the  field  of
Banking and Financial Services and undertake studies
and research projects on contract from government,
private and international agencies or institutions ;

to  plan  and  organize 
teaching  and 
training
programmes  in  the  field  of  Banking  and  Financial
Services ;
to train students and others in research methodology
with the idea of promoting knowledge and awareness
in  subjects  relevant  to  Banking  and  Financial
Services ;
to update the knowledge of its members in the field
of Banking and Financial Services to enhance their
skills and professionalism ;
to  create a forum at which the members and any other
could  voice,  comment,  communicate,  discuss  and
resolve issues of Professional and Academic interests
to  its  members  and  to  assist  in  the  formulation  of
effective policies relating to Banking and Financial
Services ;
